about: The plugin keeps its state in its own homes: the user-level state home is ~/.claude/ah2, a repository's project directory is <repo>/.claude/ah2 (or ~/.claude/ah2/project when the repository is the user's home), and every fixed name the v1 plugin kept directly under ~/.claude or <repo>/.claude lives under them. The recordings are not rewritten; the replay reads them with the layout mapped (the replay-mapping row of agent-prefix.json).

rows.recorded: ~/.claude/agent-hierarchy (the default AH_HOME, the trusted-homes and trusted-hierarchy-dirs files, trusted/<pin>.json, projects/<slug>/agent-hierarchy.json)
rows.native: ~/.claude/ah2 through Ah.Core.Text.AhPaths.HomeUnder; a v1 AH_HOME is refused with its own cause, and `ahd home trust` refuses v1's default home
<repo>/.claude/ah2 through AhPaths.ProjectDir; ~/.claude/ah2/project when the repository's real path is the user's home
rows.reason: a v1 team, message or status file in a repository stays v1's, and the two homes never coincide

rows.recorded: ~/.claude/agent-hierarchy.json, agent-hierarchy.gate.json, agent-hierarchy.ultra-gate.state, agent-hierarchy.session-roles.json, agent-hierarchy.state/, agent-hierarchy.peer-pending.jsonl, agent-hierarchy.peer-records.state, agent-hierarchy.usage.jsonl, agent-hierarchy.usage-cache.json, agent-hierarchy.usage.state; <repo>/.claude/agent-hierarchy.json and ah-conventions.json
rows.reason: the v1 plugin writes these names, so v2 cannot share them; they keep their full names so a person can tell which plugin's file is which
